verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Treasury exposes Transaction, OutboundPayment, and ReceivedDebit objects that serve as ledger entries usable for building account activity feeds and reconciliation, implying some identifier and object-based structure. However, there is no evidence describing specific counterparty detail fields, rail-specific metadata (e.g., ACH/wire trace numbers, originator info), or explicit enrichment logic that turns raw bank feed data into rich in-product data. Missing for 10: documented counterparty fields, rail-specific metadata schema, examples of enrichment/normalization beyond basic ledger entries, and independent developer corroboration of transaction data richness.
